summary: Fitness Champs Holdings, a Singapore-domiciled foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its November 12, 2026 annual general meeting. Holders of 36,617 Class A and 19,351 Class B shares, about 44.30% of total voting power, were present and formed a quorum. The principal resolution approves a two-for-one share consolidation across Class A, Class B and preferred shares, raising par value from US$0.00225 to US$0.0045, conditioned on Nasdaq notification and public announcement; fractional shares round up. This is a routine meeting-result and capital-structure housekeeping filing, not a special situation; watch the consolidation effective date and any Nasdaq compliance implications.
